verdict.rationale: stagewise documents a GitHub plugin covering repository access and pull requests, which gives the agent some PR-related capability. Shell access is only a generic building block and earns no credit. There is no documentation of the agent staging changes, writing commit messages, or creating branches. Missing for 10: documented git staging, commit message generation, branch creation, an explicit PR-creation workflow, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can have the agent stage changes, write commit messages, create branches, and open pull requests

citations.quote: GitHub: Repository access, issues, pull requests, actions.
